function &values96() { global $a,$b; echo "Y0;"; yield 0 => $a; echo "Y1;"; yield "second" => $b; echo "N;"; }
function sink96(&$first,$second=99) { echo "S:",func_num_args(),":",$first,":",$second,";"; $first=33; echo "R:",$first,";"; }
function warning96($level,$message) { global $g,$old,$b; $g->next(); $old=22; echo "H:",$g->key(),":",$old,":",$b,";"; return true; }
$a=11; $b=11; $old=&$a; set_error_handler('warning96'); echo "B;"; $g=values96(); sink96(...$g); echo "V:",$a,":",$b,":",$old,";"; unset($g);
purpose: A changed current string key must not retarget the prechecked positional slot; the saved old CELL supplies22 while current cache stays11.
